title: RUN (Vine)
blurb: Panicked, immediate, and from the era when six seconds was the entire runtime. Vine specialised in clips that skipped setup completely, and this one is a pure example — something has been spotted, exactly one response is appropriate, and the video ends before you learn what it was. Play it over animals charging, plans collapsing in real time, or the moment a parent starts counting to three. The comedy lies in how fast everybody complies: nobody stops to ask, they simply go. Urgency is absolute and entirely contagious.
origin: From the classic Vine clip; the internet's evacuation order.
